briefs.name: 2026-10-07-congress-trades-study.md
briefs.headline: Congressional trade disclosures: is there an edge? (Research Inc., 2026-10-07)
preview: **Verdict: No usable edge from the disclosure date after costs for a long-only swing desk on our 20 tickers. No signals.json changes.**
## 1. Evidence

- **Pre-STOCK Act, positive but measured from the trade date:** Senate purchases beat the market by 85 bp/month from 1993 to 1998 ([Ziobrowski, JFQA 2004](https://www.cambridge.org/core/journals/journ
- **Rebuttal:** actual portfolios lagged the market by 2 to 3% a year from 2004 to 2008 ([Eggers & Hainmueller, JOP 2013](https://andy.egge.rs/papers/EggMueller_capitol_losses_jop_2013.pdf)).

RESEARCH INC. ANALYST NOTE (2026-10-15)
Hot Sep PPI (+1.3% MoM) did not stop a defensive rotation: Dow +1.1%, SPY +0.3%, QQQ flat-to-down as money left AI/tech for health care and staples.
Our swing ideas worked: WMT +1.5% on the DB Buy, UNH +2.8%, XLV +1.9%. Avoids still right on optics (LITE −3%, COHR −5%) even as CRWV/ORCL bounced off the debt rout lows — keep them on the sideline.
WTI jumped to ~$98 (Hormuz + big EIA draw); airlines bounced but fuel >$100 Brent keeps the group avoid. Semis: SOXX still soft (−0.9%), NVDA −1.8%, AMD −1.5%.
Tomorrow: industrial production 9:15 ET and monthly opex. Next week earnings: NFLX 10/20 AMC, TSLA/IBM 10/21 AMC. FOMC 10/28. Stick to swing long-only (Trek/Rota); day desk stays closed.
